comments:
cbba2453: ;
 .;This routine prompts the user to enter or edit the DICTATED BY field (#10.02)
 .;and the DICTATED fields (#10.05 and #200) for a PROCEDURE record (#393)
 .;in the VISTA PROGRESS NOTES file (#393).
3d6617b2: ;Identify the file and field being edited and branch to the entry point.
08026bf9: ;Set up the variables for editing the DICTATED BY field.
3a1bc830: ;If the DICTATED field has a value, set DE(1) to that value.
b8a9836d: ;Output the field data value and handle word-wrapping.
84452af6: ;If the field value is longer than 19 characters, and the input transform is not 'INPUT' or 'Yes/No', go to the word-wrapping routine.
99a5b375: ;If the field is read-only and has a value, display it with a '// ' prefix. If it has no value, display '(No Editing)'.
b12fc567: ;Read user input, set DTOUT if timeout, and sound a beep if no input.
0f0ba092: ;Delete the current value of the DQ array and increment DQ.
c66a4333: ;Branch to the next input prompt.
fc219b8a: ;If there is a computed expression, execute it. Otherwise, write the field label and get user input.
5686783f: ;This code section updates the DICTATED BY field in the ^VAS(393 global array.
83b83a70: ;If DICTATED BY field is left blank, this sets the DGJTST variable to 'INCOMPLETE' and jumps to the next input field.
f5a505c7: ;End of DICTATED BY field code section.
26b42410: ;This code section processes the DICTATED field in the ^VAS(393 global array.
a63cb288: ;If field is entered, this sets the DGJTST variable to 'DICTATED'.
